base.method: Actual engine, simulate.mjs reference-board method; 30-second crowd/moving boss/stationary boss; candidate at centre/edge, better placement. Reference teams are explicit and include typical two-status and rich-status lineups. Only candidate ultimate is cast. Fixed-form rows deliberately exclude evolution cost; collector row includes its50-starlight evolution but no merges, so it is a high-wing-uptime bound, not a full-run tier list.
